summary: Live end-to-end proof of the BP2-METER post-close settle on a real orchestrate.ps1 -Budget run against a throwaway scratch repo. The full chain fires: dispatch -> done -> Rails-Settle writes integer tokens from a real transcript -> a 1-token ceiling crossed at settle -> ledger blocked/budget/tokens -> next dispatch refused. Negative control byte-identical (non-tautological). Headline finding: a TRIVIAL reaped interactive leg does not persist its own main transcript before the orchestrator's hard reap, so its tokens settle honest-UNKNOWN (never a fabricated zero); real long production legs DO persist and are measured.

findings.claim: A trivial reaped interactive leg does NOT persist its own main transcript before the orchestrator's hard reap (Stop-Process -Force at done), so Rails-Settle records honest-UNKNOWN tokens with a real wall_ms - never a fabricated zero. Verified: a 175s interactive session that wrote 10 files left ZERO jsonl at its worktree slug.

findings.claim: The settle mechanism itself is SOUND and HONEST: it measures a real Claude Code transcript to integer tokens (proven end-to-end + via the exact CLI surface), halts on a crossed ceiling (exit 7), and records the literal UNKNOWN when a transcript is unavailable - passing exactly the green-light-that-cannot-report-failure bar this wave exists to enforce.

Production impact of the gap is LOW: a real wave leg is a long ultracode session that persists its transcript DURING the run, so the live orchestrator measures real legs at done. healthwire's live main transcript measures tokens_in=21489566 tokens_out=274547.

The live orchestrator's own ledgers (real repo) currently show every leg settled=None / tokens UNKNOWN: the 11:55 run predates the settle code; the 15:14 run's legs (incl this one) had not reached done at read time - so no live measured settle exists yet independent of this proof.
